 Skip the Fees: Your guide to North Carolina's free College Application Week
 October 19, 2026 
 Posted by NC Lottery at 
 3:50 PM 
 Tweet 
 Big dreams don’t have to come with a big price tag. College application fees can cost up to $85 each, and applying to multiple schools can add up quickly. But for one week every October, North Carolina students can take the next step toward their future without paying those fees.
 North Carolina’s free College Application Week gives prospective students the chance to apply to dozens of participating universities and community colleges at no cost, all from their computers. Many North Carolina schools are waiving their application fees from October 19, 7:30 a.m. to October 25, 5 p.m.
 Don’t miss out! Watch the video below to see how you can take advantage of this opportunity before the Oct. 25 deadline.
 Your application is just the beginning! Getting accepted is exciting. Figuring out how to pay for college? That’s where even more opportunities come in. After submitting your applications, completing the Free Application for Federal Student Aid, or FAFSA, is an important next step toward accessing financial assistance.
 Completing FAFSA unlocks opportunities like the Next NC Scholarship, which helps cover tuition and fees at any state university or community college for eligible students from households with an adjusted gross income of $80,000 or less.
 Money raised by the N.C. Education Lottery helps fund college scholarship opportunities, awarding more than 1 million scholarships and grants since 2006. This year, your play supports the Next NC Scholarship and the NC Scholarship for Children of Wartime Veterans. That means  lottery dollars are helping students across the state turn their college goals into reality.
 Your story could be worth $2,000! The opportunities don’t stop once you enroll! If you’re continuing your education through a lottery-funded scholarship, our Moving NC Students Forward campaign wants to hear from you. Share your experience for a chance to be selected to receive a $2,000 prize. Your story could inspire someone else to take the next step toward their own dreams.
 Ready to take the next step? Watch the video below, then explore the complete list of participating colleges and universities to see where your future could take you. Create your account at CNFC.org to get started through the Application Hub. Your next chapter could be just one application away!
